methodology.source: Saved annual run trades.csv files referenced by runs/batches/**/summary.json.
methodology.windowPolicy: Simple tenor-aware windows: weekly uses 13/26/52 cycles, 14d uses 6/13/26 cycles, monthly uses 3/6/12 cycles.
methodology.rollingVolatilityPct: Sample standard deviation of cycle return percentages inside the rolling window.
methodology.rollingAverageCycleReturnPct: Arithmetic average of cycle return percentages inside the rolling window.
methodology.rollingDownsideVolatilityPct: Sample standard deviation of negative cycle return percentages inside the rolling window.
methodology.rollingDrawdownPct: Worst peak-to-trough drawdown inside the rolling window using compounded cycle returns.
methodology.windowReturnPct: Compounded return over the rolling window.
